title: Rock and metal kit: synthesized guitars, drums, riffs and feels
description: Rock and metal as data: synthesized (CC0) guitar tiers (clean, crunch, high gain), palm mutes, chugs, leads, harmonics and feedback, bass guitar, rock and metal drum kits (double kick, blast, thrash, fills), organ, strings, a wordless vowel voice; riff grammar, a 72-bar song form and five feel templates, generated by tools/concepts/build.mjs.

ingredients.title: Rock and metal racks
ingredients.description: Chain-only hook defs: gtrClean, gtrCrunch, gtrHigh, palmMute, chugHigh, gtrLead, gtrHarmonic, feedbackSwell, bassFinger, bassPick, rockKick, metalKick, rockSnare, rockHat, rockRide, crashCym, rockTom, organ, rockStrings, vowelVox

ingredients.title: Rock and metal atoms
ingredients.description: glyphcore/rockmetal atoms (rm.): drum patterns (rock, shuffle, half-time, double kick, blast, thrash, doom), fills, power chords, riff cells and grammar (A A A B), chug, gallop, breakdown, bass and lead lines, chords, the 72-bar song form as gates.

ingredients.title: Feel: Straight rock
ingredients.description: Feel template "Straight rock" (100-140 bpm): kick 1, 3 and the and of 3, backbeat, 8th hats, crunch riff. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Shuffle
ingredients.description: Feel template "Shuffle" (90-130 bpm): triplet-grid shuffle: kick and hats on the triplet grid, backbeat. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Rock / metal half-time
ingredients.description: Feel template "Rock / metal half-time" (120-160 bpm (felt half)): half-time snare on 3, ride quarters, high-gain riff. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Thrash
ingredients.description: Feel template "Thrash" (160-220 bpm): skank beat (kick on beats, snare on offbeats). Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).

ingredients.title: Feel: Doom
ingredients.description: Feel template "Doom" (55-80 bpm): slow and heavy: kick once a bar, snare on 3, held doom riff and bass. Slots drums (kick, snare, perc), top (hats, top), bass, harmony, fx, groove; per voice <v> (pattern), <v>Vel (accents), <v>Rack (rack | groove).
